metaTitle: Custom Henley Work Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom henley work shirts for your team. Durable, comfortable, and perfect for branding. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Henley work shirts offer a rugged yet professional look that standard polo shirts or button-downs can't match. The signature button placket and soft collar provide a clean appearance that works on the job site or in the office. Made from durable cotton blends, these shirts hold up to frequent washing while keeping your crew comfortable. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, cohesive team uniform that stands out from the competition.
heroAltText: Custom henley work shirts with embroidered logo on the chest, featuring a button placket and short sleeves.
